answer: Anchor each agent to one identity bond: joining locks 30 POA in a shared vault, and the bond decays 5% per epoch unless the agent keeps doing honest work. An attacker wanting 100 fakes must lock 3,000 POA, and the sable ledger lists every bond's age, so fresh-bond floods show instantly. Keeping 100 fakes alive costs 150 POA per epoch, more than fakes earn. An honest agent pays 30 POA once, renews for 1.5 POA per epoch, and keeps its full share.
